chart-bar-big: outlined bars fill the plot; a cut leaves an open bracket
chart-bar-stacked: outlined bars fill the plot; a cut leaves an open bracket
chart-column-big: outlined bars fill the plot; a cut leaves an open bracket
chart-column-stacked: outlined bars fill the plot; a cut leaves an open bracket
chart-candlestick: candles fill the plot; a cut opens a candle
chart-waterfall: bars fill the plot, no seat 2 clear
chart-diagram: a corner cut opens the top box into a bracket
chart-network: nodes leave no seat; a cut breaks a ring
chart-line-up: arrowhead and line leave no room for two stars 2 apart
euro: room for one star only, in the mouth of the C
gauge: small star finds no seat 2 clear of the dial dots
square-trending-up: the arrow leaves no seat inside for the small star
shopping-bag: the small star would cut the handle
briefcase: handle and clasp block every seat for the small star
coupon: the side notches sit where a corner star cuts
earth: a corner cut takes a continent line
git-pull-request: a corner cut takes the arc
piggy-bank: every seat cuts the ear or a leg
store: a corner cut takes the door
